item.title: Robust Error Handling & Custom Errors
item.description: Let’s be real for a second: writing code when everything goes right is easy. The real test of a web application is how gracefully it behaves when things inevitably go wrong. The network drops, an API returns invalid JSON, or a user uploads a corrupted file. :') If your app just silently crashes or leaves a blank white screen, users leave. Here is how to structure robust error handling in modern JavaScript.
